# hiok_storage_account (Data Source)

Look up an existing storage account by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hiok_storage_account" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `primary_region` (String)
- `redundancy` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `tier` (String)
